SessionStart.command: export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/go/bin:$HOME/.local/go/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; P="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-.}"; R="$P/../../.."; if [ -f "$R/cmd/hq/main.go" ]; then if [ ! -x "$R/bin/hq" ] || [ -n "$(find "$R/cmd" "$R/internal" "$R/templates" -name '*.go' -newer "$R/bin/hq" -print -quit 2>/dev/null)" ]; then (cd "$R" && go build -o "$R/bin/hq" ./cmd/hq && "$R/bin/hq" migrate --quiet) >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; [ -x "$R/bin/hq" ] && exec "$R/bin/hq" hook session-start; fi; [ -x "$P/bin/hq" ] && exec "$P/bin/hq" hook session-start; command -v hq >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec hq hook session-start; exit 0

hooks.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; P="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-.}"; R="$P/../../.."; [ -f "$R/cmd/hq/main.go" ] && [ -x "$R/bin/hq" ] && exec "$R/bin/hq" hook pre-tool; [ -x "$P/bin/hq" ] && exec "$P/bin/hq" hook pre-tool; command -v hq >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec hq hook pre-tool; printf '{}\n'

Stop.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; P="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-.}"; R="$P/../../.."; [ -f "$R/cmd/hq/main.go" ] && [ -x "$R/bin/hq" ] && exec "$R/bin/hq" hook stop; [ -x "$P/bin/hq" ] && exec "$P/bin/hq" hook stop; command -v hq >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec hq hook stop; exit 0
